heroHeadline: Houthis Strike Riyadh Airport, Airlines Halt Flights; UN, UK and Arab States Issue Joint Condemnation
heroSubtitle: Houthi forces claimed a missile strike on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, prompting airlines to suspend flights to the Saudi capital. The UN, UK, and Arab states issued a joint condemnation of Houthi drone and missile attacks on Saudi airports, calling for immediate de-escalation.
footerNote: Data sourced from Saudi Press Agency, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Washington Post, Bloomberg, NBC News, CNN, NPR, ABC News (Australia), TASS, Türkiye Today, Anadolu Agency, News.Az, Yemen Monitor, Arab News, UN OCHA, UN News, World Health Organization, Security Council Report, CFR Global Conflict Tracker, Trading Economics, and the US Senate Armed Services Committee record. Contested claims flagged with opposing perspectives.
